contracts.title: North Northamptonshire Council - RFQ - Family Hubs - Evaluating the Effectiveness of Funded Services
contracts.description:
This Request for Quotation (RFQ) has ben published on behalf of the Early Help Commissioning Manager at North Northamptonshire Council.

North Northamptonshire Council invites quotations from providers to deliver comprehensive evaluation support for the Family Hubs Programme.  The Council is seeking an evaluation partner to assist in:

•	Understanding the impact of services funded through the Family Hubs Programme, both direct (services provided through the programme) and indirect (broader outcomes and ripple effects).
•	Exploring the transformation process by which the programme delivers its intended outcomes, identifying key areas of success and opportunities for improvement.
•	Assessing the programme's contribution to its defined outcomes and goals for stakeholders, including families, communities, and service providers.

The evaluation partner will play a crucial role in developing an evaluation plan to support ongoing monitoring and evidence-gathering. The plan will focus on:

•	Measuring the programme's outcomes and overall impact in a structured and evidence-based manner.
•	Informing future commissioning decisions, ensuring resources are directed toward the most effective and impactful services.
•	Supporting the development of the Council's new Early Help Offer, explicitly identifying which services should be expanded, modified, or scaled back based on insights gathered during the evaluation of pilot projects.

This work is expected to provide robust, actionable insights to help the Council optimise service delivery, maximise the benefits of its investments, and achieve sustainable positive outcomes for its stakeholders.  The Council's detailed requirements are defined in Section 2: Specification.

North Northamptonshire stop smoking service includes a 12-week treatment plan incorporating NRT products, provided only to individuals aged 12 and above who are engaged in the stop smoking programme and receiving behavioural support with regular contact from a stop smoking advisor.

Cycle training in Northamptonshire is currently outsourced to a single contractor and is delivered via the Government's Bikeability scheme. A focus of the programme is supporting the areas identified as Left Behind Communities.  These are Kingswood in Corby; Avondale Grange in Kettering; and Queensway in Wellingborough. The NHS Health Check programme aims to reduce avoidable premature mortality by early identification and management of cardiovascular risk factors and disease in people aged between 40 and 74 years who have no previous history of CVD disease. In Northamptonshire, 46 in every 100,000 people die before the age of 75 from cardiovascular disease considered preventable, which is similar to the England average (45 per 100,000).

North Northamptonshire Council (hereafter referred to as the 'Council') and on behalf of West Northamptonshire Council wishes to invite Tender Responses for the supply of services in respect of Public Health Northamptonshire Dental Epidemiology Survey. 
      
      To examine the oral health of specified population groups, as outlined in the guidance published by the Office  of Health Improvement and Disparities (OHID)  - formerly known Public Health England (PHE). The provider will use  caries diagnostic criteria and examination techniques based on those agreed by the British Association for the Study of Community Dentistry (BASCD) , for caries prevalence surveys and using sampling procedures described in BASCD guidance on sampling for surveys of Child Dental Health.
      
      The survey population is defined as per the National Dental Epidemiology programme Protocol  and associated documents. The Provider will complete the minimum sample size as set out in the National Protocol. In Northamptonshire, the minimum sample size will be applied to both North and West Northamptonshire Council's. Additional to this, extended sampling will be required for each of the 7 locality areas: Corby, Kettering, East Northamptonshire, Wellingborough, Northampton, Daventry and South Northamptonshire.

contracts.title: North Northamptonshire Council and West Northamptonshire Council - Tier 2 Home Care Services
contracts.description:
North Northamptonshire Council ("NNC") and West Northamptonshire Council ("WNC") wishes to invite Tenders for the supply of Tier 2 Home Care Services. The successful Provider(s) will be responsible for providing support to the Lead Providers and liaising closely with the Contract Manager identified by NNC and WNC.
NNC and WNC are procuring a framework with the intention of selecting suppliers across fifteen (15) Home Care Services Lots. The framework is for three years with an option to extend for 24 months. NNC and WNC currently have contracts with Lead Providers in the 15 Geographical Zones. The lead providers aim to cover 70-80% of the available volume of home care in each Operational Zone.  This framework is for a list of approved providers to cover the remaining 20-30% of volume in each of the geographical zones and will replace the existing Dynamic Purchasing System(DPS) which expired in 2019.

If during the life of the framework a Provider becomes unable to fulfil their contractual requirements under the awarded Lot or Operational Zone, NNC and WNC will, at their discretion, reopen the framework to source a new provider.

In general terms and for the purposes of this Tender, 'Home Care Services' should be taken to mean treating a Service User with dignity, compassion and respect, focusing on their health and well-being. Offering a personalised co-ordinated method of care, support or treatment, and supporting the Service User to recognise and develop their own strengths and abilities to enable them to live a fulfilling life (this definition should not be considered as exhaustive).

Please note below the Tier 2 Home Care Services Framework is reopening the following Lots only:

•	Service Lot 2: Corby & District Zone 2

•	Service Lot 3: Kettering & District Zone 1

contracts.title: North Northamptonshire Council on behalf of West Northamptonshire Council (Formerly Northamptonshire County Council) NHS Health Checks DPS (Dynamic Purchasing System)
contracts.description:
The NHS Health Check programme aims to reduce avoidable premature mortality by early identification and management of cardiovascular risk factors and disease in people aged between 40 and 74 years who have no previous history of CVD disease. In Northamptonshire, 75 in every 100,000 people die prematurely before the age of 75 from cardiovascular disease. Under the Health and Social Care Act 2012, local authorities have a legal responsibility to commission and monitor their local health check programme. All local authorities must offer an NHS Health Check to 100% of their eligible population every 5 years by inviting 20% of the eligible population each year over the five year period. In Northamptonshire 228,466 people are eligible for an NHS Health Check meaning that 45,694 people should be offered a check each year. Public Health England expect that 66% of health checks offered should be taken up equating to 27,417 checks delivered each year.

This DPS Agreement is for an initial term of three years, with an option to extend for a further two years. The DPS Rounds will be closed for evaluation at the Council's discretion from Round 3 onwards; however, Providers will be able to apply for the DPS at any time within a Round. 

Please note, the current round is Round 9 and we are using a 1 year extension. This DPS Agreement is for an initial period of 3 years (up to 31st March 2022) with an option to extend for a further period of up to 2 years, taking the total contract term to a maximum of 5 years and has currently been extended to Friday 31st March 2023. Any extension will be agreed between the Council and the Provider(s).The deadline for completed applications within "Round 9" to be received on the ProContract eTendering Portal is 12:00noon on Wednesday 25th May 2022. Please see ProContract for details of future Round deadlines.

Please note, the Authority is now North Northamptonshire Council (formerly Northamptonshire County Council).
